title: A Undertow for the Aftermath
author: Ada Thackeray
blurb: Coral Whitlock, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
